evals.prompt: the activities monthly calendar feels really cramped on mobile — the day cells are tiny and you can't read the event titles, they just get cut off. we should make it more usable on phones, maybe show a better view when there are lots of activities in a day. can you log this so we can plan it later

evals.name: sync-toast-spins-forever-bug
evals.prompt: getting a weird bug — sometimes the 'Saving...' toast just spins forever and never flips to saved. happened twice this week, both times on my iphone running the installed PWA. the data actually seems fine after I reload the app, it's just the toast that gets stuck. file this as a bug
evals.expected_output: A complete proposed issue (preview, no row created): classified as a Bug; Current Behavior (toast stuck on Saving...) and Expected Behavior (resolves to saved/last-saved) filled; repro detail (twice this week, iOS PWA, data fine after reload) folded into References; Surfaces platform includes Mobile (PWA)/iOS; generate mockup? proposed No; research points at the relevant sync/save store + toast code; provenance shown; stops at the approval gate.
